facsimile.method: Manual visual reading of all twelve branch/stem sets from the rendered original PDF page, not inferred from the runtime table. PDF has no usable extracted Chinese text here. Pages 40/55 were search probes, not extra verified passages.

orderingLimit: UI puts conventional primary stem first; poem order is retained here and does not establish primary/secondary quantitative weights. Actual installed lunar-typescript agrees with the selected display order.

passages: 卷五 1a–4b 論古人立印食官財名義
tenRelations.method: Read the passages on day master, five generating/controlling relations and same/opposite polarity; implement the ten labels and compare all 100 ordered stem pairs with executed lunar-typescript. Practical Vietnamese descriptions are editorial prompts, not translations of fate claims.
tenRelations.limit: WYG identification is supplied by the digital repository. This is a pinned transcription, not a fully collated facsimile of San Ming Tong Hui.

notAdopted.finding: Seasonal day-allocation tables contain alternatives and differ from fixed twelve-branch hidden-stem sets (for example 子 includes 壬癸). They are not substituted for the fixed table, and no day weights are inferred.

evidenceLevels: Downloaded scan bytes and derivative page hash
remaining: No complete study of these books; no independent verification of predictive efficacy, full 1926 volume, all textual variants, strength weights or useful-god choice.
